mintAuthority.summary: Canonical Ethereum USDx has two live MARKET_ROLE holders: USDxMarket and the 3-of-5 governance Safe. The Safe can call token mint directly without market capacity or collateral checks, as well as administer roles, routes and capacity. Proxy upgrades separately require a two-day timelock whose proposer and executor are the same Safe. Offchain reconciliation and key independence remain unverified.
mintAuthority.headline: A governance Safe can mint USDx directly without collateral checks; proxy upgrades have a separate two-day delay.

controls.evidence: Complete deployment-to-block-26197360 token and market role history and current hasRole calls confirm USDxMarket retains MARKET_ROLE; the Safe is the only other holder. Fresh MarketConfig getters and all 216 configuration logs confirm four enabled USDC/USDT routes and channels, enabled mint/redeem, one registered custodian and unchanged 20m/1m USDx per-block maxima. No CapSet events exist. These limits constrain signed-order settlement, not direct Safe token minting, and are not executable redemption-liquidity commitments. No BRIDGE_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE or RESTRICTION_ROLE grants appear in the token census; the Safe can grant them. The pin is Ethereum 26197360, 2026-10-15T10:37:11Z, via https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com.

controls.label: Axis published mint operator
controls.capDescription: Executes signed mint orders through account, signature/delegation, nonce, route/channel and capacity checks; the pinned market block-mint maximum is 20m USDx. Governance can change limits and separately mint directly.
controls.evidence: Complete deployment-to-26197360 RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history and current hasRole identify this as the sole MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE holder; the separate sole redeem operator is 0xde195deca3b698584aa106cdea77bbab0edcab03. Current issuer contract-address docs identify this exact mint operator as "Settles signed mint orders (KMS-secured)"; issuer security docs say "Key material is managed with AWS KMS." These disclosures do not establish non-exportable asymmetric KMS signing, use of KMS Sign, or equivalent HSM-resident signing keys. AWS KMS also supports plaintext private data keys for signing outside KMS, so no HSM custody attestation is inferred. Operator independence, IAM approval policy and recovery controls remain unverified. It executes signed settlement, while the governance Safe separately retains direct token mint authority. The pin is Ethereum 26197360, 2026-10-15T10:37:11Z, via https://api-ethereum-mainnet.n.dwellir.com.

review.evidence: Complete deployment-to-26110188 role census establishes Safe administration, market plus Safe token minters, the sole published mint operator, no bridge-role grants, and Safe-governed 172800-second proxy upgrades. At 26114911 the market and Safe implementation/handler runtimes match verified source. Deployment-to-26114911 MarketConfig census (183 logs) and pinned getters close four USDC/USDT mint/redeem routes and channels, no CapSet events, and 20m/1m USDx mint/redeem block maxima. Market settle/mint/redeem share signed account/nonce/route validation, capacity consumption and atomic ERC20 movement plus USDx mint/burn; settlementData is hashed, not executed. Configured token/destination addresses introduce no generic calldata execution. Safe fallback methods add no persistent unquorummed issuance bypass; signed arbitrary execution and self-authorized control mutation remain unbounded adverse reach. Incident review covers the exact canonical V2 deployment on July 23, 2026 through block 26122473 (October 5, 2026 00:06:59 UTC; hash 0x2ad181b79dfa7dc5f5c23f6130815c66322c76d9f84c269439a676395aef492c). Eleven contiguous unfiltered 50000-block-or-smaller ranges beginning with Safe creation at 25597751 returned all 16849 token, market, config, Safe, timelock and vault logs. The 94 token mint events comprise 59 market mints and 35 direct Safe mints in 29 successful transactions. The two relayed mint transactions enter MetaMask DelegationManager 0xdb9b1e94b5b69df7e401ddbede43491141047db3 through redeemDelegations(bytes[],bytes32[],bytes[]) (selector 0xcef6d209). Their calldata nests Safe.execTransaction calls with 195-byte signature bundles: recovery values 31/28/28 at block 25925402 (September 7, 2026 12:13:11 UTC) and 31/28/27 at block 25946088 (September 10, 2026 09:27:47 UTC). These select the Safe's ECDSA/eth_sign recovery branches, not its contract-signature or module entry points; delegation validation at the outer manager is separate from the Safe owner-signature checks. Each proxy has only its deployment Upgraded event; the timelock has no scheduled or executed calls. Current implementation, Safe mastercopy and handler code match the prior reviewed runtimes; role membership, 3-of-5 owners, empty modules, zero guard and two-day delay are rechecked at the same pin. Issuer security/audit disclosures, the complete documentation index, announcements index and governance disclosure were reviewed on October 5; no relevant incident or postmortem was identified. Governance documents no public proposal/voting process. All 1293 DeFiLlama hack records were searched for Axis, Coordinate and USDx with no name matches; scoped public incident searches likewise found no attributable report. Remediated audit findings are not treated as deployed incidents, and unrelated Axis entities or other USDX tokens are excluded. This establishes no known relevant incident within the reviewed public and onchain scope, not absence of undisclosed offchain loss or proof of reserve reconciliation. Offchain reconciliation, supervision and independent signer/operator custody remain separately unresolved; no protective cap or independence credit is inferred.

What controller-specific approval policy, signer-to-organization separation and recovery arrangements establish independent authorization? Hardware-wallet custody is disclosed but is not an MPC or HSM attestation.

scopedQuestions.question: The exact mint operator is disclosed as KMS-secured, and Axis says key material is managed with AWS KMS. Is this operator's signing key a non-exportable asymmetric KMS key used through KMS Sign, or an equivalently HSM-resident key, rather than exportable data-key material? Naming KMS alone establishes neither HSM key residency nor independent authorization or a signing threshold.
